UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public user profile and application preferences for an authenticated GHOSTNOTE archivist. Contains no PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name or alias of the archivist.

photoURL.description: Avatar URL if provided by auth provider, or empty string.

scanlinesEnabled.description: Whether CRT scanlines overlay is enabled.

lowEffectsMode.description: Whether low-effects GPU mode is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record storing the user's email address in a private subcollection.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

StoryEntryDoc.title: StoryEntryDoc
StoryEntryDoc.description: A supernatural diary story entry stored inside a user's personal archive subcollection.

id.description: Unique entry identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the entry owner.

title.description: Literary title of the supernatural story.

originalNote.description: Raw memory fragment or note submitted by the user.

style.description: Literary horror style used for generation.

wordCount.description: Total word count of the story.

providerMode.description: AI provider mode used to generate the entry.

providerLabel.description: Human-readable provenance badge for the AI provider.

isSample.description: True if generated via offline sample mode.

clientCreatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string for UI display and export compatibility.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created in Firestore.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated in Firestore.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each user's public profile and UI/AI preferences.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores each user's isolated PII (email) accessible only to the owner.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores each user's personal supernatural diary entries.
